create_smpl_data_provider: create a SmplDataProvider from an npz file and SMPL model pkl file using the factory function
get_posed_skin_vertices: get posed SMPL mesh vertices for a given frame index in XSens Z-up convention
get_global_timespan: get the first and last timestamp in microseconds from the SMPL data provider
access_smpl_faces: access the triangle face indices from the SMPL model via the faces property
load_smpl_parameters: load per-frame SMPL betas, body pose, global orientation, and translation from an npz file
